content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A digital product store with no-KYC payments is an infrastructure solution that enables creators to sell their products directly to consumers without the barriers established by conventional payment platforms. This method is particularly significant in regions where traditional payment processors impose restrictions or high fees, effectively shutting out many aspiring entrepreneurs. By using cryptocurrency for transactions, creators can enhance their autonomy and reduce costs. In contrast to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale, the alternative infrastructure can significantly increase revenue by only charging a 0.5% fee through NOWPayments.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC digital product store integrates several key components that work in synergy. Hosting is done via platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, offering a stable and cost-effective environment for your products. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script execute automated processes, such as payment verification and order fulfillment. Orders are stored using Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring data ownership and control. Finally, file delivery happens through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to provide instant access to digital products. This architecture is designed to be robust yet straightforward, providing a foundation that creators can build upon.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators operating in regions where payment access is limited. Whether you’re selling ebooks, online courses, templates, or software, the no-KYC payment architecture provides a vital solution. It is particularly beneficial for creators in countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where conventional payment methods may not be viable. By removing the dependency on traditional platforms and costly fees, creators can focus on what they do best: creating. This architecture empowers them to build sustainable businesses without the financial strain imposed by existing systems.
Retain 99.5% of your earnings with low transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of a no-KYC digital product store hinges on the seamless integration of various components. Hosting via GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages ensures that your storefront is accessible globally at no cost. The backend, powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, handles payment processing and order management efficiently. Supabase or Google Sheets stores customer orders securely, giving you direct access to your data. The NOWPayments integration allows you to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, automatically converting payments to your preferred currency at the moment of transaction. This entire stack is designed for sovereignty, ensuring that creators retain ownership and control.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your no-KYC digital product store, first choose your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up the backend using either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring all necessary functions for payments and order fulfillment are in place. After that, store your orders using Supabase or Google Sheets. Now, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions and configure your product listings. Finally, test the entire system to ensure everything works smoothly before launching. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the blueprints and templates necessary for deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a no-KYC payment solution. By setting up a digital product store using cryptocurrency payments, you can bypass the limitations of conventional platforms and retain more profit. This approach not only enhances your revenue but also provides you with full control over your transactions.
Unlock global sales potential without platform restrictions.

If you're exploring how to sell templates and fonts without relying on Gumroad or Payhip, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the tools you need to create an effective digital store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our offerings.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by creating your own digital product store. By leveraging cryptocurrency payments, you can bypass the limitations of these platforms.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose which ones to accept based on your target audience and their preferences.
How can I ensure data ownership in my digital store?
By using platforms like Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, you ensure that you retain full ownership and control over your customer data without relying on third-party services.
